messages:
Priya N: dropped a new prototype for a compact toolbar inside eval runs: https://figma.com/file/wxyz9876. idea is collapse-to-pill on narrow widths or when users enable compact mode. want quick feedback on discoverability + a11y. :mag: Jordan C: saw it. love the tighter layout. concern: when collapsed, how do keyboard & screen reader users discover the controls? is there a persistent focus target? Marta L: +1. collapsing on scroll is risky. prefer collapse based on container width or explicit toggle. also need a clear aria-label and visual indicator of active filters even when collapsed. Samir R: agree re: triggers. add: what happens with pinned filters (user toggled state)? will the pill reflect pinned state? Priya N: plan: collapse when container width < 760px OR when compact mode is enabled. no scroll-collapse. keep a persistent toggle pill with aria-label="Open toolbar" and a visible counter for active filters. opening moves focus to first interactive control. animation 120ms. Jordan C: ensure Tab lands on the pill. Enter/Space should open it. after open, focus should programmatically move to first control (e.g., sort dropdown). Marta L: for SRs we should add an aria-live announcement only on state change. lightweight example we can ship with the PR: ```html
``` Samir R: make sure sr-only uses standard CSS (not visibility: hidden) so NVDA/VoiceOver pick it up. also verify on VoiceOver iOS; aria-live behaves differently there. Priya N: copy thought: use 'Open toolbar' instead of 'Show filters' since toolbar includes sort/snapshot too. objections? Jordan C: fine. keep tooltip minimal (mouse users only). don't cram shortcut hints into the tooltip. separate keyboard shortcuts doc. Marta L: add acceptance criteria for a11y: 1) toggle reachable by keyboard; 2) Enter/Space opens toolbar and moves focus to first control; 3) aria-live announces state transitions; 4) active filter pill visible in collapsed state; 5) documented SR test matrix (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver desktop/mobile). Samir R: add test tasks: keyboard-only navigation, focus order capture, unit test for DOM role/aria updates. I'll add Jest/dom-testing-library checks for aria-live content and focus move. design-bot: Accessibility checklist updated: compact-toolbar -> persistent-toggle, aria-live, visible-filter-pill, focus-move-on-open, animation <=200ms. See /docs/accessibility/toolbar-collapse.md :white_check_mark: Priya N: thanks team. I'll update prototype and open a small PR with the aria-live helper + keyboard focus management. Follow-ups: @Jordan C write keyboard test cases; @Marta L run screen reader passes on VoiceOver + NVDA; @Samir R add unit tests. target: behind feature flag next sprint. :rocket:
